banks.title: Listening GT Section 3: Perencanaan Proyek Survei Kursus Bisnis

questions.prompt: Which business have the students decided to study?
questions.explanation_id: Mereka batal memilih kafe karena empat kelompok lain sudah memilihnya: "We're going to look at the second-hand bookshop on Mill Street instead."

questions.prompt: Why does Dr Marsh advise against an online questionnaire?
questions.explanation_id: Banyak pelanggan adalah pensiunan: "They're much less likely to answer an online survey". Karena itu ia menyarankan wawancara tatap muka.
options: The shop does not have a website
Many customers are unlikely to respond online
correct_answers: Many customers are unlikely to respond online

questions.prompt:
Complete the notes. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER.

Minimum number of customers to interview: ________
questions.explanation_id: Mahasiswa mengusulkan 20, tetapi dosen mengoreksi: "I'd say you need at least thirty."

questions.prompt: Choose TWO letters. Which TWO problems with the shop do the students identify?
questions.explanation_id: Tom menyebut papan nama yang kecil dan pudar, dan Priya menyebut "the opening hours are quite limited". Harga dinilai wajar dan lokasi Mill Street ramai.
options: The sign outside is hard to see
correct_answers: The sign outside is hard to see

questions.prompt: Who will be responsible for each task?
questions.explanation_id: Priya merancang pertanyaan ("I'm going to design the interview questions"), Tom menghubungi pemilik toko ("I'll be the one who contacts the owner"), dan analisis dikerjakan bersama ("We thought we'd do that together").

questions.prompt: Before each interview, students must obtain written ________ from the interviewee.
questions.explanation_id: Dosen menegaskan: "you must get written consent from each person".

questions.prompt: Maximum length of the final report: ________ words
questions.explanation_id: Batas tahun lalu 2.500 kata, tetapi sekarang: "The final report must not be more than three thousand words".

questions.prompt: Length of each group presentation, including questions: ________ minutes
questions.explanation_id: Presentasi berdurasi "fifteen minutes. That includes time for questions from the audience".

questions.prompt: Recommended reading: a guide to ________ design
questions.explanation_id: Dosen merekomendasikan buku di perpustakaan: "a guide to questionnaire design".

questions.prompt: When will the next meeting take place?
questions.explanation_id: Selasa dosen menghadiri konferensi, jadi ia mengusulkan "Thursday morning instead, at ten", dan kedua mahasiswa setuju.
